g.text: FireBeetle 2 ESP32-E: two supply gauges (A0, A1) and a DS18B20 (D2)

g.desc: FireBeetle 2 ESP32-E: two supply gauges (A0, A1) and a DS18B20 (D2)

g.text: Served to the PLC as a Modbus TCP server over Wi-Fi (code: Part 1, phase C)

g.desc: Served to the PLC as a Modbus TCP server over Wi-Fi (code: Part 1, phase C)

g.text: Gauge live zero: dead supply 0.49 V, healthy 1.98 V, broken wire 0 V

g.desc: Gauge live zero: dead supply 0.49 V, healthy 1.98 V, broken wire 0 V

g.text: USB power only. Nothing above 3.3 V on any pin. No mains.

g.desc: USB power only. Nothing above 3.3 V on any pin. No mains.

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Gauge 1 = MAIN supply (R1-R8) -> A0 / GPIO36. Gauge 2 = BACKUP supply (R9-R15) -> A1 / GPIO39.

g.desc: Gauge 1 = MAIN supply (R1-R8) -> A0 / GPIO36. Gauge 2 = BACKUP supply (R9-R15) -> A1 / GPIO39.

g.text: Each gauge: top 10k+4.7k+1k from the supply, bias 100k+22k from 3V3, bottom 22k to GND, 1M pull-down.

g.desc: Each gauge: top 10k+4.7k+1k from the supply, bias 100k+22k from 3V3, bottom 22k to GND, 1M pull-down.

g.text: DS18B20 (U1) on D2 / GPIO25 with a 4.7k pull-up (R16). The sensor cable shield is not connected.

g.desc: DS18B20 (U1) on D2 / GPIO25 with a 4.7k pull-up (R16). The sensor cable shield is not connected.

g.text: Breadboard tests, measured at the pin against GND (gauge 1 / gauge 2):

g.desc: Breadboard tests, measured at the pin against GND (gauge 1 / gauge 2):

g.text: sag: R1 supply wire moved from 3V3 to TP1 (SAG), so the supply comes through R7 47k -> 1.10 V (gauge 1 only)

g.desc: sag: R1 supply wire moved from 3V3 to TP1 (SAG), so the supply comes through R7 47k -> 1.10 V (gauge 1 only)

g.text: dead: supply wire unplugged, the 100k+22k bias keeps a live zero -> 0.488 V / 0.489 V

g.desc: dead: supply wire unplugged, the 100k+22k bias keeps a live zero -> 0.488 V / 0.489 V

g.text: broken wire: wire from the gauge to the ESP32 pin unplugged -> 0 V / 0 V

g.desc: broken wire: wire from the gauge to the ESP32 pin unplugged -> 0 V / 0 V

g.text: (on the breadboard the 1M sits at the pin end of that wire, so a broken wire reads 0 V, not a floating value)

g.desc: (on the breadboard the 1M sits at the pin end of that wire, so a broken wire reads 0 V, not a floating value)

g.text: Power: USB only. Nothing above 3.3 V on any pin. No mains anywhere.

g.desc: Power: USB only. Nothing above 3.3 V on any pin. No mains anywhere.
